note.value: The power that Mistellia placed within this white, two foot long Crystal Dagger gave Remianath mighty powers in melee combat. It has a mind of its own and cuts through boarders and defenders in a furious bloodlust.
The Dagger may only be bought for an Admiral's vessel and permits the Admiral to add +3 to the boarding total instead of +1. If the Admiral changes ship the Dagger goes with him.
